it: Capopalestra della Palestra Pokémon di Forestopoli: \nAlice

id: The bird user taking flight into the world.
en: The bird user taking flight into the world.
it: L'Allenatrice di uccelli che spicca il volo nel mondo.

id: \bI wish I had Crobat with me. It would love this event. Well anyways, why don't we have a quick battle?
en: \bI wish I had Crobat with me. It would love this event. Well anyways, why don't we have a quick battle?
it: \bVorrei avere Crobat con me. Adorerebbe questo evento. Beh, comunque, perché non facciamo una lotta veloce?

id: \bBrock: I think I'm gonna look around and see if I can't find the Gym Leader. I hear she is really cute. See you around.
en: \bBrock: I think I'm gonna look around and see if I can't find the Gym Leader. I hear she is really cute.  See you around.
it: \bBrock: Credo che farò un giro per vedere se trovo la Capopalestra. Ho sentito che è davvero carina.  Ci vediamo.

id: Fortree City\nThe treetop city frolics with nature.
en: Fortree City\nThe treetop city frolics with nature.
it: Forestopoli\nLa città sugli alberi che si diverte con la natura.

id: \bSo what if he can't fly? He is still a Flying type.
en: \bSo what if he can't fly? He is still a Flying type.
it: \bE allora se non sa volare? È comunque un tipo Volante.

id: \rWinona: Are you next for a ride?
en: \rWinona: Are you next for a ride?
it: \rAlice: Tocca a te fare un giro?

id: \rOh, you came to challenge me? I got so caught up in the festivities I forgot about the gym.
en: \rOh, you came to challenge me? I got so caught up in the festivities I forgot about the gym.
it: \rOh, sei venuto a sfidarmi? Mi sono fatta prendere così tanto dai festeggiamenti che mi sono dimenticata della palestra.

id: \rMeet me inside. I'll be ready for you.
en: \rMeet me inside. I'll be ready for you.

id: \bYou're just in time for the Feather Carnival. It's a celebration of Flying types.
en: \bYou're just in time for the Feather Carnival. It's a celebration of Flying types.
it: \bSei arrivato giusto in tempo per il Carnevale delle Piume. È una festa dedicata ai Pokémon di tipo Volante.

id: \rMy Charizard is hot stuff, huh? The best Flying type around.
en: \rMy Charizard is hot stuff, huh? The best Flying type around.
it: \rIl mio Charizard è una bomba, eh? Il miglior tipo Volante in circolazione.

id: \bI heard there's some serious trouble in the Weather Institute on Route 119. Might be good to lend them a hand.
en: \bI heard there's some serious trouble in the Weather Institute on Route 119. Might be good to lend them a hand.
it: \bHo sentito che all'Istituto Meteo sul Percorso 119 ci sono seri problemi. Potrebbe essere una buona idea dargli una mano.

id: \bWinona's helping out with the Feather Carnival right now, so she's not in her gym anyway.
en: \bWinona's helping out with the Feather Carnival right now, so she's not in her gym anyway.
it: \bAlice sta dando una mano al Carnevale delle Piume, quindi comunque non è nella sua Palestra.

id: \bI love it over here. So quiet.
en: \bI love it over here. So quiet.

id: \bI'll give you this if you don't tell anyone I'm here.
en: \bI'll give you this if you don't tell anyone I'm here.
it: \bTi do questo se non dici a nessuno che sono qui.
